scripts.migrate: wrangler -c wrangler.jsonc d1 migrations apply hub-db --remote
scripts.next-build: wrangler -c wrangler.jsonc d1 execute hub-db --remote --command "SELECT h.id, h.tier, COALESCE(c.name, 'Positive Tribes') AS client, h.added_by, h.title, h.details, h.note FROM hub_ideas h LEFT JOIN clients c ON c.id = h.client_id WHERE h.status = 'next' ORDER BY h.id"
